companyFieldUpdates.description: Pivot Energy Inc. is a Denver-based U.S. independent power producer that develops, finances, builds, owns and manages distributed commercial and community solar and storage projects. ECP IV-owned Pivot Energy, Inc. completed a US$67 million purchase of substantially all assets and most liabilities of the TCA-controlled predecessor on June 1, 2021. ECP continues to list the platform as current; exact ECP fund percentages and the full holding chart are not publicly disclosed. Pivot reported approximately 4.3 GW and about 1,000 completed and 900 developing projects for 2025. Project lenders, tax-equity providers, HASI project-joint-venture capital, Microsoft and individual project or portfolio entities are not company-level owners. A possible ECP stake-sale process was reported in April 2025, but no buyer, signed agreement, closing or ownership transfer was found through August 19, 2026.
